blocks.text: SOP: shop tool checkout and end-of-day board

This is the working cut for RDW-SOP-2023-022 on March 2, 2023. Owen Pike asked for a written bound after the current path (Tools land where the job ends) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host tools.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on leave specialty tools in the cab overnight, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

I am not restating a hallway yes. leave specialty tools in the cab overnight is out because February 9 scan tool rode home in a customer truck. 2.4 hours to get it back. Nina made the call.
